concerns.text: "The research question is: Can a generative model learn to accurately simulate the dynamics of complex systems? The method is: We will train a recurrent neural network..." This question and method are unrelated to the original idea, which focuses on auditing public A/B test summaries for statistical consistency.

"FR-027: System MUST ensure that no single source domain accounts for >30 % of the total corpus..." The original idea did not request any domain‑bias weighting or subsampling; this adds scope that was not part of the research question.

"FR-030: System MUST generate a synthetic validation dataset of at least 10 000 simulated A/B test summaries..." The idea only required a manually annotated real‑world validation set of ≥100 summaries. Requiring a large synthetic dataset expands the scope beyond what was asked.

The ABSummary entity defined in FR‑002 lacks a `source_domain` attribute, yet FR‑027 and the plan’s Phase 2 I04 reference `source_domain` for bias handling. This mismatch creates an undefined requirement and prevents the stated bias‑adjustment feature from being implemented.
